description: This source file defines the CategoryRepository class responsible for fetching content items for different categories in an Android TV application. It interacts with an ApiService to retrieve data from network endpoints and provides fallback sample data in case of network failure.

classes.name: CategoryRepository
classes.description: Repository class that manages fetching categorized content items, with network call implementations and fallback sample data.

methods.name: sampleItemsFor
methods.description: Generates a list of sample ContentItem objects for a given HomeCategory, used as a fallback when network requests fail.

methods.name: fetchCategory
methods.description: Public suspend function to fetch ContentItems for a given HomeCategory, attempting network calls and reverting to sample data on failure.

methods.name: sampleItemsFor
methods.description: Generates placeholder ContentItems based on category, used when network data fetch fails.

methods.name: fetchCategory
methods.description: Fetches content for a category, attempting network request and falling back to sample data on error.
